OFFLINE HOURS · VOLUME ONE

Stroke Guide

Slow Mornings · Cursive Calligraphy & Coloring Book

Pick a letter and watch how it is written, one stroke at a time. Follow along with your finger first, then try it on the matching page in your book.

A

  1. Watch the whole letter once.
  2. Trace it in the air or on the table with your finger.
  3. Write it slowly in your book, following the numbered arrows.

Little tips for lovely cursive

  • Sit comfortably, relax your shoulders, and hold the pen lightly.
  • Keep a gentle, even slant, and let your letters lean the same way.
  • Slow is beautiful. Speed comes naturally with practice.
  • Use the faint middle line to keep your lowercase letters the same height.
  • Short, regular sessions work better than one long one. Ten quiet minutes is plenty.
